decision_conditions: The Council has considered your application and confirms that the proposals are acceptable as non-material amendments to the planning permission set out above. For the purposes of this decision, condition no.2 of planning permission reference 26/00672/HOU shall be replaced with the following condition: REPLACEMENT CONDITION 2: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan E197, Proposed Block Plan E198B, Existing Block Plan E199A, Proposed floorplans E200B, Existing Floorplan E201, Proposed sections E202B, Building Sections E202aRevA, Proposed elevations E203B, Proposed elevations E204B, Existing elevations E205, Existing elevations E206, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement, SuDS proforma, SuDS management plan, Flood Risk Assessment and CIL formReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
